test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

It is always advised to include a visit to the Sun temple of Konark in your __itinerary__, if you are planning to visit Odisha.

options.text: travel document that records the route of journey
holiday to a far off place
long and tedious journey without any rest

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word underlined in the sentence "It is always advised to include a visit to the Sun temple of Konark in your itinerary, if you are planning to visit Odisha." is 'itinerary'.
 
• The term 'itinerary' refers to a planned route or journey.
 
• Among the given options, option 1, "travel document that records the route of journey" best substitutes 'itinerary' without losing information in the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "diary with travel related notes" An itinerary could contain travel related notes, but it primarily includes a plan of places to visit which is not clearly stated in this option.
 
• Option 3: "holiday to a far off place" This doesn't maintain the original sense of a recorded plan for a journey.
 
• Option 4: "long and tedious journey without any rest" This not only misses the meaning about planning a journey but also adds unnecessary negative connotations.
